input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including lock info. The platform provides capabilities for klock aspect handler, lock timeout handler, release timeout handler. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to create and manage lock info records, so that I can track and organize lock info data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to use release timeout handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
